item.title: By: Lynn Cornish

item.description: Thank you Elio. I think the more we acknowledge that we have those mind structures and that they are part of our very nature, the more we can see through them to the emptiness. I don't know if I'll ever be free of them, but as they say, what you resist persists, so I resist not!

I don’t know if I’ll ever be free of them, but as they say, what you resist persists, so I resist not!

item.title: By: Lynn Cornish
item.dc:creator: Lynn Cornish
item.description:
Where's the "Like" button?
I scare myself sometimes thinking what if what I'm doing is not the thing I should be doing. I have my doubts about...everything, really. I'm not much of a believer and I stand on a groundless ground. Help! No, I'm usually pretty okay there. Just some days....
So it's nice to hear that everything is just as it is and that's good enough for me. Who could argue that it isn't? No worries indeed.
item.content:encoded:
Where’s the “Like” button?

I scare myself sometimes thinking what if what I’m doing is not the thing I should be doing. I have my doubts about…everything, really. I’m not much of a believer and I stand on a groundless ground. Help! No, I’m usually pretty okay there. Just some days….

So it’s nice to hear that everything is just as it is and that’s good enough for me. Who could argue that it isn’t? No worries indeed.
